name: sc4sap
description: SuperClaude for SAP (sc4sap) transforms Claude Code into a full-stack SAP development assistant. It connects to your SAP system via the MCP ABAP ADT server (150+ tools) to create, read, update, and delete ABAP objects directly — classes, function modules, reports, CDS views, and more. The plugin includes 26 SAP-specialized agents (core dev agents + CBO stocker + BC consultant + 14 module consultants for SD, MM, FI, CO, PP, PS, PM, QM, TR, HCM, WM, TM, Ariba, BW), workflow skills (create-program with execution-mode gate and parallel Phase 4/6, create-object, analyze-code, analyze-symptom, analyze-cbo-obj, setup, and an internal-only session trust bootstrap), and built-in SPRO configuration reference with BAPI lists, transaction codes, and representative workflows for every module. Designed for SAP consultants, ABAP developers, and Basis administrators working with On-Premise S/4HANA systems.

plugins.name: sc4sap
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for SAP ABAP development on On-Premise S/4HANA — 26 specialized agents, 15 workflow skills (create-program with Phase 4/6 hardening + multi-executor split, create-object, program-to-spec, program-to-manual (end-user HTML manual), compare-programs, analyze-code/symptom/cbo-obj, package-to-process for end-to-end business-process documentation, ask-consultant, setup, internal trust-session), 4-Tier context loading, Sonnet/Opus model routing, OK_CODE binding pattern, paradigm-split Clean ABAP, and SPRO config reference for 14 modules.
